A new page appears here automatically whenever
[TidyTuesday](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday) publishes a new
weekly challenge. Every dataset in a challenge gets its own section, and every
variable in a dataset gets a distribution plot — histogram or bar chart
depending on its type — titled with the variable name and subtitled with its
official description. See [About](about.qmd) for how the automation works.
